origin.mapping: world_x = easting - 389500; world_z = 5820000 - northing; world_y = metres
origin.ring: ring vertices are scene (x, z) pairs in decimetres; closing vertex omitted
origin.tone: optional per-prism [r, g, b] 0-255: per-channel median of the drawn overview raster under the ground footprint; absent when no valid raster sample exists (viewer falls back to class shades)

source.name: Berlin LoD2 + OSM context building prisms (drawn-isometric mode)
source.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors · 3D building models: Geoportal Berlin (dl-de/zero-2-0)
source.geometry_status: Authoritative LoD2 footprint polygons take precedence; a non-overlapping OSM sidecar supplies context buildings where LoD2 is absent. Rings are simplified at 0.15 m; heights stay unsnapped and source-qualified; ground comes from IDW over committed detail samples
source.tone_source: Per-prism 'tone' sampled from the committed drawn overview (overview_source.png, Step 8 render of the LoD2/OSM/Wikimedia-cue stack) at the z=0 ground footprint via the exact overview projection
